fixed.what_changed: AC-7 rewritten so the vacuity guard is per-rejection-path, not shadow-only: the shared premise is retained.mode='shadow' (SessionManager.ts:2977), and on top of it (a) the mutation-identity-missing path only rejects when runtime.admission.mode === 'server', because the branch records the blocker unconditionally but returns `runtime.admission.mode !== 'server'` (2986), while (b) the driver-lease-failure path rejects whenever exactRegisteredView combined with either serverAuthorityUserMutation or legacyDriverMutation is false (3008-3010), independently of admission mode. AC-7 now explicitly states that a shadow-only test that leaves admission mode unfixed can observe acceptance and still pass, so it does not satisfy the AC. New AC-8 adds boundary controls: identity-missing under a non-'server' admission mode must be observed to be ACCEPTED, and an identity satisfying exactRegisteredView plus the mode-specific acceptance conjunction must be observed to be accepted; if both controls reject, the test is not measuring fencing rejection and cannot be used as evidence. Rationale effectivity paragraph, Verification Method and the SessionManager trace note corrected to distinguish the two paths' preconditions. No metadata row and no other requirement touched.

fixed.what_changed: Rationale replaced with a per-site account of three distinct behaviours instead of the false claim that all four sites detect 0-size: (1) dimension-checked silent give-up at the initial-mount double-rAF (guard 3862, return 3868), the ResizeObserver callback (guard 4112, return 4117) and the visibility-transition handler (guard 4306, return 4312); (2) no dimension check at all in the imperative fit() handle (2991-2997), which tests only isVisibleRef (2992), emits no debug event, and calls submitTerminalFit regardless of a 0x0 container (2995) — this removes the contradiction with AC-3 inside the same block; (3) performRepairLayout (1184-1213), which skips and then reports success via resolve(true) (1196) without setting geometryReadyRef, so its caller repairLayoutAfterIme (1215-1222) reads an unopened barrier as opened. performRepairLayout added as a fifth site to the Requirement paragraph and to the TerminalView Trace Links row, and the imperative fit() citation corrected from 2991-2996 to 2991-2997. New AC-7 makes 'skip then report success' a separate defect: skip must not return success, no combination of returned-true with geometryReadyRef=false may remain, and verification must observe the return value together with geometryReadyRef rather than the return value alone. AC-1/AC-4 tension resolved: AC-1 now requires re-measurement without further ResizeObserver events and convergence to true only if dimensions recover within the retry budget, and explicitly defers the never-recovering case to AC-4, which requires ending in a non-ready state carrying an observable terminal signal rather than flipping geometryReadyRef to true. AC-3 extended to cover the visible-but-0x0 case that the imperative handle currently cannot detect. Verification Method gained the AC-4 exhaustion case and the AC-7 boundary control (a non-zero container must yield true together with geometryReadyRef=true).
